title: Bag-Valve-Mask (BVM) Resuscitator with Bacterial/Viral Filter
author: Open Critical Care & World Health Organization
caption: Manual bag-valve-mask (BVM) ventilation device equipped with a bacterial/viral filter for emergency airway and ventilatory support.
